analyst-confidence.description: Analyst confidence in the classification of the whole path (metadata.analyst_confidence).

data-risk-event.description: Union of the Data Risk Events of all steps. C=Confidentiality; I=Integrity with Ii=incorrect state, If=misattributed state; A=Availability/Accessibility with Av=unavailable, Ac=inaccessible (data present but unusable, e.g. ransomware). Outcomes, never causes.

entry-cluster.description: Cluster of the first step of the attack path. Absent when the first step is unresolved.

framework-ref.description: Framework dictionary file the classification refers to (metadata.framework_ref).

incident-id.description: Incident identifier from the Layer 3 attack path file (metadata.incident_id).

layer3-json.description: The source TLCTC Layer 3 attack path JSON file (json-schemas/layer-3/tlctc-attack-path.schema.json).

notation.description: Full TLCTC attack path notation, e.g. #10 ||[update][@Vendor→@Org]|| →[Δt=instant] #7 →[Δt=~14d] #4 →[Δt=~2h] #1 + [DRE: C]

notes.description: Analyst notes for the whole path (metadata.notes).

reference.description: Source URL (advisory, report, blog) the analysis is based on.

tlctc-version.description: TLCTC framework version the path was classified against (metadata.tlctc_version), e.g. 2.5.

description: A TLCTC (Top Level Cyber Threat Clusters) attack path: the ordered sequence of cause clusters observed in one incident, with attack velocity, boundary crossings and Data Risk Events. References each tlctc-attack-step object with "includes". TLCTC v2.5, https://www.tlctc.net
name: tlctc-attack-path
